main_text.l: Vox contracta, orta, ut quidam volunt, ex illo
הוֹשִׁיעָה נָא Serva quæso, Psal.118.25. Esth.3.8.in Targ.
sec. Vide quæ de hac voce scripserunt, Tremellius
in Not. Matt.21.9. Angelus Caninius cap.4.de locis
S.Scripturæ Hebraicis. Drusad voces Hebr. N.T.
*יָשַׁר Hebr. Rectum esse vel videri.
מִשְׁרָא, מִישְׁרָא, מִישָׁר Ch.Planicies, planum, vallis, locus
planus, campestris. Plur. מִשְׁרִין, מִשְׁרָיָא Campestria,
valles. Vide praeterea in שְׁרָא.
יֽת Ch.Articulus accusativi casus, respondens Hebraeo אֶת.
יִתְב Ch. & Syr. Sedit, manset, habitavit, in-
habitavit, Hebr. יָשַׁב. Pahel יְתַב Sedere, habi-
tare, habitabile facere, collocare. Aphel אוֹתִיב Idem.
Ithpah. אִתְיְתַב & אִתּוֹתַב Habitari, inhabitari: Item Pe-
regrinari, Ut peregrinus habitare in aliquo loco.
Vide praeterea in תּוּב.
יַתִּיב Ch.Habitabilis: Fœm. יַתִּיבְתָּא Exod.16.35. & יְתִיבְתָּא
Jesa.54.1.
יִתּוּב Ch. Habitatio, Jobi 10. v.ult.
מוֹתְבָא, מוֹתַב Ch. ܡܬܒܐ Habitatio, habitaculum, se-
des, cathedra. Plural. מוֹתְבֵי, מוֹתְבִין, Syrè, ܡܬܒܝ
Throni, ad Col.1.16. ܡܬܒܐ ܪܫܐ Primas sedes,
primos accubitus, Lucæ 11.43.
מוֹתְבָן Ch. Idem. Plur. מוֹתְבָנִין, Esth.1.2.in T.sec.
תּוֹתְבָא Ch. Idem, Ezech.16.2.
מְתִיבְתָּא, מְתִיבְתָא Ch.Confessus, Schola, Gymnasium,
Academia, Cantic.2.4. רֵישׁ מְתִיבְתָּא Caput, id est,

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are reproduced as far as legible; the Syriac forms in the lines with ܡܬܒܐ and ܪܫܐ are approximate and marked as doubtful in the scan. Several vowel points above the Hebrew letters are faint.
